title: Git Workshop
introLead: Have you ever wondered how Git actually works, or how to use it like a pro?
introRest: In this workshop, {{leadName}}, a 3rd-year AI student, will show you both the basics and the crazy side of version control. He’s been frustrated for a while that the curriculum doesn't teach us this properly, so now he's taking matters into his own hands and sharing skills that will actually save you during projects—both on campus and in your future career.
whatYouLearnIntro: Whether you have used Git since kindergarten or never heard of it, you will get a lot out of the workshop. It is aimed at everyone and will cover everything from the basics to the more unusual concepts such as:

topics.1: What Git is and what is actually happening under the hood
topics.2: The most common commands for everyday use
topics.3: Undoing, fixing, and how to change history
topics.4: Practical walkthrough of conflicts and problems
topics.5: Good standards, tips, and tricks for large projects

whatToBringTitle: What do I need to bring?
whatToBringIntro: The only thing you need is a laptop, so remember to {{installGit}} before Tuesday and make sure you are at least a little familiar with the terminal. Everything will happen without a fancy interface in the terminal so that you actually know what is going on.
contact: If you have any questions, contact @jokko4 on {{discordLink}}! See you there!
